operatorApproval.notes:
The audit's earlier integrity scans were one-off scripts: they counted records, recomputed canonical hashes and listed dangling evidence paths, but they could not answer the question the X-series exposed - whether a fresh clone can walk the chain at all, since the record schema has no parent pointer and the chain is forward-only (parent.nextTaskId + parent.nextBaseSha must name a child record with that taskId and baseSha). The scanner ranks generations (out-chain > out-final > out-corrected > later corrections > out, negative-control generations scanned but never canonical) and separates canonical offenders from superseded history. On a clean checkout of the X-series tip it reports 87 records, 87 canonical-hash matches, 87 field-conforming, 55 forward links resolved and 8 offenders: five X-series chain parents naming a child while untracked - the conclude flow emits a chain generation after amending the evidence commit that would carry it, so those records only ever reached the working tree - and three historical (E02's negative-control generation names an E03 base no record carries, FIX-2 names FIX-3 whose record was never emitted, T09 names T10, a task the plan never contained). This unit commits those chain records and reports the residue honestly instead of rewriting the historical PASS records that produce it. | CHAIN: this record supersedes X07/out-corrected (kept immutable), whose nextBaseSha named the pre-amend evidence commit; the child is cut from de6254b1a7c2, the evidence commit as it stands now.

X15 correction: the forward pointer carried by this generation names a record that was never emitted, and the unit that actually continued from this commit is named instead. The correction is a new generation (out-chain); the record as first emitted stays in `out` unchanged, and AUDIT/integrity-scan.mjs reads generations from highest rank down, so the corrected pointer is canonical and the original is reported as a superseded-generation link. Every field not named below is byte-identical to the record it copies; see X15/logs/04-link-truth-table.txt for the commit facts, and X15/logs/01 and 03 for the scanner defect that had hidden part of it (unit ids ending in a letter were skipped outright, and the script had no exit status).

Basis: X07 was emitted terminal; X08/out-chain.base (45d42acb) descends from X07's result 548c2a83.
